issues.message: 2 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when 让 lattice init 的 .gitignore 复制路径以 registry 为真相源合并 runtime ignore 块，并 resync 主仓 .gitignore + 回归保护：clean main 上 thin-init-assets-smoke 通过 + 防 registry→gitignore 再漂移的断言 are performed simultaneously?)

None of the checklist items have the files field filled in (legacy story compatibility mode); cannot perform coverage validation on understanding.touchpoints. Please list the changed files in files.modify/create/test for at least one item to enable strict touchpoint-to-files validation

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. `scope_check_save` already exists; a lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must persist the result through `scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not Authority Server completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full Authority completion.
